candidate_spec: Native active uses exact original R3 module, R7-C23 public-only belief revision, and one predeclared extra action rule. At a current state, compute native preferred action after ingesting the current front observation. Only if native preferred action is a turn, compare the immediately observable after-turn forward-cell information gain of BOTH left and right. If preferred turn points to a previously observed blocked cell, while alternate turn points toward never-observed edge with non-worse Manhattan distance to goal, substitute that single alternative turn. Never probe if facing clear forward when planner prefers forward. No privileged object identity or future observation. Native episode belief source and actual action outcomes identical. Never count arbitrary turns as beneficial unless later goal/reward improves.
conventional_bayesian_spec: Fitted original-public motor learned from same FIT, discounted Beta per directed edge as R7-C23; checkpoint serializes whole temporal posterior and base plan/visits and cold-restores full Bayesian state
conventional_active_spec: Independently implemented conditional learned motor+public per-edge Beta belief, same frozen informative-turn decision rule using only its own past public observations; fully serialized and cold restored; comparator more favorable than naive recent-only.
controls: Include previously observed native-selective without active turn and conventional persistent exactly-fit same public data. Bayesian comparator full checkpoint solves R7-C23 omission. Independent exact semantic repeat, no hidden source map/tile identity, no tuning on previously exposed R7-C23 seeds.
measures: actual goals and native task reward
actually selected informative turns and repeat front states
complete per-step original public action and outcome traces
cold-process exact restored subsequent choice for all models
FIT CPU, DEV CPU, peak process RSS, complete persisted model bytes
two independent processes per arm, science-identical transcripts
predeclared_advance: Native active only useful if statistically and functionally improves original-world goals OR action costs without worsening either family, and beats strongest equally informed conventional comparator; if not science NO-GO. Any novel mechanism scientific promotion requires independent FORGE prereg and heldout separate.
governance: Mass Research independent evaluation branch, owner native R1/R2/R3 left immutable and DRAFT, no protected first-use, no FORGE/CKB plane control, no paid APIs, no main merges
